user.title: Set up cover automation
user.description: Step 1 of 4: Which area should have automatic covers? Areas with covers are offered.

data_description.area: Each area is set up once and gets its own device.

room.title: {area}: covers and sensors
room.description: Step 2 of 4: Entities from the area {area} are suggested.

covers_section.name: Covers
covers_section.description: The automation controls these covers. You set up each one next.

data_description.presence_entity: When someone is present, covers open during the day.
data_description.sleep_entity: Switch that indicates sleep mode. Without it there are no sleep positions.
data_description.climate_entity: Heating or cooling decides whether sun is let in or blocked while nobody is home.

window_section.name: Window
window_section.description: While the window is open, the cover opens at least to the window position.

data_description.window_entity: Leave empty if there is none.

sun_section.name: Sun and shading
sun_section.description: When does the sun shine directly on this window, and how far should the cover close?

data_description.orientation: Compass direction the window faces, or an azimuth in degrees (e.g. 145).
data_description.shading_position: Leave empty to use the room's shading position.
data_description.shading_conditions: Optional. All conditions must be met to shade.

outdoor.title: Outdoor sensors
outdoor.description: Step 4 of 4: These apply to the whole house and are suggested for the next area.

data_description.illuminance_entity: Used for shading and solar gain.
data_description.dusk_entity: Without it, sunset counts as dusk.

data_description.presence_label: If none of these sensors is on, the house counts as empty. Without a label it always counts as occupied.
